overview: An extension of the HTML `<button>` element (or an `<a>` tag styled as a button) that communicates action intent through five color variants. Optional `prepend` and `append` slots allow icons or avatars to be placed before or after the label. The `as` prop lets the button render as an anchor for navigation actions while retaining button styling and accessibility attributes.

whenToUse: When triggering an action or submitting a form
When navigating to another page or URL, but should appear as a button
do: Use default for the single most important action on a view
Use secondary for secondary or supporting actions alongside a primary button
Use destructive for irreversible actions such as delete or remove
Use as="a" with an href for navigation - this ensures correct semantics and keyboard behavior
Add icons via prepend or append only when they aid comprehension, not for decoration
dont: Use buttons with no click handler (make disabled if so)
Use a button when a plain text link is sufficient for low-emphasis navigation
